exposure.needed: which monitoring systems or alerting rules actively reference the old metric name lbipam_ips_available_total at runtime

original.statement: The metric lbipam_ips_available_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_available.

decision.reason: [ev-875bb56564b0] only says the metric `lbipam_ips_available_total` was renamed to `lbipam_ips_available`. An environment is exposed only if its dashboards, queries or alert rules use the old name, and no Helm value, manifest field or flag shown in the evidence would reveal that. An undecidable exposure is therefore the honest condition. Any configuration-based predicate would flag too many environments or miss some.
